scenes.subtext: My keys were on this desk.
scenes.narration: The car park camera shows my car leaving at four this morning. My keys have been on this desk since I came in.

scenes.text: IT CAME BACK AT FIVE PAST FIVE
scenes.subtext: Parked crooked, the way I park.
scenes.narration: It comes back at five past five and parks in the same bay, a little crooked, the way I park.

scenes.subtext: There was rain on the windscreen.
scenes.narration: I went down with a torch. The bonnet was warm. There was rain on the windscreen, and it has not rained tonight.

scenes.narration: The driver's seat has been moved back two notches. I have not moved that seat in nine years.
